questions.question: What is the company's total net sales after returns?
questions.derivation: Sum of fact_sales.net_sales (Source A, already net of returns).

questions.question: What is the total gross sales value before any returns?
questions.derivation: Sum of shipments.net_sales (Source B, gross, returns included); equals SUM(fact_sales.gross_sales).

questions.question: What is the total value of returns?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND((SELECT SUM(net_sales) FROM b.shipments) - (SELECT SUM(net_sales) FROM a.fact_sales), 2)
questions.derivation: Source B net_sales total minus Source A net_sales total; equals SUM(sales_returns.return_amount).

questions.question: What are net sales after returns for the brand Nordwind?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.net_sales), 2) FROM a.fact_sales f JOIN a.dim_product p ON p.sku = f.sku WHERE p.brand = 'Nordwind'
questions.derivation: fact_sales joined to dim_product, brand = Nordwind.

questions.question: Which categories does the brand Alpine Spring have products in?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM a.dim_product WHERE brand = 'Alpine Spring'
questions.derivation: dim_product rows with brand = Alpine Spring.

questions.question: What are net sales after returns for the Juice category?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.net_sales), 2) FROM a.fact_sales f JOIN a.dim_product p ON p.sku = f.sku WHERE p.category = 'Juice'
questions.derivation: fact_sales joined to dim_product, category = Juice.

questions.question: How many units were shipped from Lyon Works?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(s.units) FROM b.shipments s JOIN b.plants pl ON pl.plant_code = s.plant_code JOIN a.dim_location l ON l.city = pl.plant_city WHERE l.location_name = 'Lyon Works'
questions.derivation: Lyon Works is plant code PL01 in Source B; sum of shipments.units where plant_code = PL01.

questions.question: What are net sales after returns for sales through distribution center DC-N1?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.net_sales), 2) FROM a.fact_sales f JOIN a.dim_location l ON l.location_id = f.location_id JOIN b.distribution_centers d ON d.dc_city = l.city WHERE d.dc_code = 'DC-N1'
questions.derivation: DC-N1 is Rotterdam Hub in Source A; sum of fact_sales.net_sales at Rotterdam Hub.

questions.question: Which plant codes shipped goods to Milan Depot?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.plant_code FROM b.shipments s JOIN b.distribution_centers d ON d.dc_code = s.dc_code JOIN a.dim_location l ON l.city = d.dc_city WHERE l.location_name = 'Milan Depot'
questions.derivation: Milan Depot is DC-S1 in Source B; distinct shipments.plant_code where dc_code = DC-S1.

questions.question: Which SKUs exist in both the sales mart and the ops mart?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT sku FROM a.dim_product INTERSECT SELECT item_sku FROM b.items

questions.question: How many SKUs exist only in the ops mart?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT item_sku FROM b.items EXCEPT SELECT sku FROM a.dim_product)

questions.question: How many units of the brand Sol Mar were shipped?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(s.units) FROM b.shipments s JOIN a.dim_product p ON p.sku = s.item_sku WHERE p.brand = 'Sol Mar'
questions.derivation: shipments joined to dim_product on SKU (item_sku = sku), brand = Sol Mar.
